TWO REFUSALS THAT MUST NOT BE READ AS EACH OTHER. An outage reported as an actor-binding failure tells an operator a caller presented an unknown key when the truth is the trust store was unreachable, and the two send an investigation to opposite places. The reverse is worse: a revoked binding reported as an outage invites a retry against a store that will keep saying the same thing.

THE INJECTIVITY CONTROL is the one an ordinary happy-path battery does not reach. Under a naive join, a signer name containing the delimiter could resolve using a DIFFERENT signer's key id — a key confusion at the exact point the pipeline decides who signed.

NOT THE RUNTIME TRUST PLANE. Its tiers, caching windows and revocation channel are THM-0097 through THM-0100's. Not a claim about which keys a deployment trusts: the resolver answers from what it was given.
